plan: Given my value of $24, I aim to maximize profit by bidding slightly above the expected average bid of others. Assuming others bid based on typical values ($10-$15), I'll bid $17 to win while minimizing payment. This bid balances winning odds and profit, assuming others bid close to their values.

Given my private value of $20, I aim to maximize profit by winning the auction at the lowest possible cost. Since values are uniformly drawn and unknown to others, bidding slightly above the midpoint ($10) can balance winning chances and cost. A bid of $15 should outbid most potential bids without overpaying, ensuring a reasonable profit margin if I win.
